explanations.meaning: a period of continuous running, often as a form of exercise
sentences: I went for a run this morning.

explanations.meaning: to move at a speed faster than a walk, never having both or all feet on the ground at the same time
sentences: She runs every morning to stay fit.
He ran to catch the bus.

explanations.meaning: a continuous flow of something, often liquid
sentences: The river has a strong run after the rain.
There is a run of bad luck in the team.
